'''The Duros Dooku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who attended the [[Galactic Costume Extravaganza]] held by [[Elwis Bontraar]] onboard [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the ''[[Masquerade]]'' the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] his [[Jennalyn Bontraar|daughter]] went missing. The Duros's [[Clothing/Legends|costume]] at the party was based on old images of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].
